masthead.title: Your favorite motorcycle rental site
masthead.subtitle: A space for two-wheel lovers, where speed and freedom meet

about.title: We have what you need
about.description: The motorcycle you need, ready for you. Easy, fast and secure rental.

security.title: Safety First
security.description: Each motorcycle undergoes rigorous technical inspections before each rental. We include certified protective equipment and accident insurance. Your peace of mind is our top priority on every kilometer.

coverage.title: National Coverage
coverage.description: Planning an interstate trip? We have partnerships in multiple cities. Return your motorcycle at any of our associated branches. Travel without limits throughout the national territory.

reservation.title: Instant Reservation
reservation.description: Forget about endless paperwork and complicated procedures. With our online system, reserve your motorcycle in less than 3 minutes. Receive immediate confirmation and get ready to ride.

pricing.title: No Surprise Pricing
pricing.description: Everything included in your rate: insurance, helmet, gloves and roadside assistance. No hidden costs or additional charges at the end. Total transparency from the moment of your quote.

fleet.title: Updated Fleet
fleet.description: Latest generation motorcycles with cutting-edge technology. From urban scooters to adventure bikes for off-road. Find the perfect companion for every type of trip.

experience.title: Premium Experience
experience.description: Personalized advice to choose the ideal motorcycle. Welcome kit with maps and recommended routes. We make your trip an unforgettable experience.

onlineBooking.title: Online Booking
onlineBooking.description1: Booking system from the web or mobile application.
onlineBooking.description2: Immediate confirmation and secure online payment option.

delivery.title: Home Delivery and Pickup
delivery.description1: Motorcycle delivery service at the customer's location.
delivery.description2: Pickup at the end of the contract, saving time and travel.

rental.title: Rental by hours, days or weeks
rental.description1: Flexibility in rental times according to user needs.

guides.title: Guides and Recommended Routes
guides.description1: Digital maps with safe and tourist routes.
guides.description2: Driving tips in the city or on the highway.

callToAction.title: With your account, save your favorite routes and access your preferred motorcycles faster

contact.title: Let's keep in touch
contact.description: Do you have suggestions on how we could improve our services, or questions and issues, don't hesitate to contact us
